parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name to query. You can specify up to 500 domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If you specify multiple domain names, the data is aggregated.
If you do not specify this parameter, aggregated data for all your accelerated domain names is returned.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity to query data. Unit: seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported time granularity depends on the maximum time range per query. For more information, see **Usage notes**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the carrier. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query carriers. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all carriers is returned.

parameters.name: Layer
parameters.description:
The dimension to query. Valid values: network layer (IPv4 or IPv6), application layer (http, https, or quic), or all.
Default value: all.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query regions. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all regions is returned.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time must be in UTC.
The minimum time granularity is 5 minutes.
If you do not specify this parameter, data in the last 24 hours is queried.
